# Krama OS

> Local-first engineering workspace and knowledge tree for solo builders.

Krama unites strategic quarterly planning, structured technical documentation, and daily task execution into a single unified workspace.

## Documentation and Navigation
- [Workspace Dashboard](/app/): Overview of active projects, scheduled focus tasks, and daily habit metrics.
- [Execution Board](/app/board): Agile Kanban board for task tracking, bug resolution, and engineering workflows.
- [Knowledge Tree](/app/brain): Hierarchical document repository for Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and engineering specs.
- [Strategic Goals](/app/goals): OKR pacing engine and objective tracking.
